name: supermind
description: Product development with automatic capability discovery and human-confirmed reuse.

interface.longDescription: Turn product intent into working software while automatically discovering capability candidates. Assess business-independent abstraction and value, then require human confirmation for every reuse or adaptation. A standalone local Python CLI synchronizes immutable memory events with your private GitHub repository. Browse the expanded categorized README tree and capability cards. Models and vectors stay local; no resident service is required.
defaultPrompt: Use Supermind to build this product intent.
Use Supermind to add this feature.
Use Supermind to improve this product.
Use Supermind to show the capability library.
